summary.title: 2. Unsupervised learning
summary.one_liner: This scikit-learn user guide chapter gives an overview of unsupervised learning methods, including Gaussian mixtures, manifold learning, clustering, matrix decomposition, covariance estimation, outlier detection, density estimation and neural networks.
takeaways: Unsupervised learning covers Gaussian mixtures, manifold learning, clustering and biclustering.
Matrix factorization methods such as PCA, kernel PCA, ICA, NMF and LDA decompose data into components.
The chapter also covers covariance estimation, novelty and outlier detection, and density estimation.
Neural network models for unsupervised learning are included as a final section.
